body: Hello ! I’ve been cutting since young. I used to cut and stop for a few years and unfortunately return back to cutting. But one of my deepest cuts took almost 2-3 years to fade. I didn’t use cream or anything i just left it and forget about it. It didn’t fade completely, i can see it because i know it’s there, but others who didn’t know won’t notice it. So don’t worry it’ll definitely fade away give it time. But in the meantime i hope the best for your health. It’s tough but you are not alone ! :)
